title: 1945 State Department document on Nazi-linked companies in Latin America

tellings.quote: So, there's a State Department document which talks about how this was in 1945, they'd already realized hundreds of new companies have been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina

plain: A State Department document from 1945 is said to note that hundreds of new companies had already been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina, as part of a story about Nazi-linked money moving to Latin America. The researcher Jason Simosa brings it up on the show, drawing on the writer Peter Levenda, and he gives his own summary rather than the document's words. If he is right, it would mean US officials knew right away that Nazi money and networks were escaping abroad as the war ended.
